text: [1] I cried out to the LORD when I was in trouble (and he answered me):
“LORD, deliver me [2] from lying lips and a dishonest tongue!”
What more will be given to you, what more will be done to you, you dishonest tongue?
Just this: [3] a warrior’s sharpened arrows, coupled with burning coals from a wood [4] fire!
Oh, I’m doomed because I have been an immigrant in Meshech, because I’ve made my home among Kedar’s tents.
I’ve lived far too long with people who hate peace.
I’m for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
